fictional_notice: Kettle & Bloom Coffee Roasters is a fictional business created for a public portfolio project (WP_AI_Support_Agent). It is not a real company. Any resemblance to an actual business is coincidental.
name: Kettle & Bloom Coffee Roasters
description: A specialty coffee roaster based in Bengaluru, India, selling single-origin and blended coffee direct to consumers online and on WhatsApp, and supplying wholesale coffee to cafes, offices, and restaurants across the city.

location.roastery_address: 14/2 Kanakapura Main Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038

contact.whatsapp_support_hours: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM IST, Monday to Sunday

shipping_policy.summary: We ship pan-India via our courier partners. Orders placed before 2 PM IST are dispatched the same or next business day.

domestic_zones.zone: South India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Kerala)

shipping_policy.shipping_fee_note: Free shipping on prepaid orders above 999 INR; a flat shipping fee applies below that threshold.

return_policy.summary: We accept returns or replacements for damaged, defective, or incorrect items within 7 days of delivery. Because coffee is a perishable food product, we cannot accept returns of opened bags for reasons of taste preference.
conditions: Item must be damaged, defective, or not what was ordered
Customer must share photos of the issue for verification
Equipment (grinders, brewers, scales) can be returned unused in original packaging within 7 days

wholesale_info.summary: We supply roasted coffee to cafes, offices, restaurants, and event organizers across Bengaluru, with pan-India shipping available for larger accounts.
wholesale_info.process_note: Wholesale pricing and contracts are handled by the wholesale team directly; the WhatsApp assistant collects initial requirements and hands off the conversation.

payment_methods_note: Payments are handled securely through our website checkout at the time of ordering. The WhatsApp assistant never collects payment or card details.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: Our Indiranagar roastery and WhatsApp support are open 9 AM to 7 PM IST, seven days a week.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Bengaluru orders typically arrive in 1-2 days, South India in 2-4 days, and the rest of India in 3-6 days.

faqs.question: Is shipping free?
faqs.answer: Shipping is free on prepaid orders above 999 INR. Below that, a flat shipping fee applies at checkout.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: We accept returns or replacements within 7 days for damaged, defective, or incorrect items. Opened coffee bags can't be returned for taste preference since coffee is a perishable food product.

faqs.question: How fresh is the coffee?
faqs.answer: We roast in small batches and dispatch most orders within 1-3 days of roasting.

faqs.question: Can I get my coffee pre-ground?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can choose a grind setting for your brew method at checkout on our website.

faqs.question: Do you offer a coffee subscription?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a monthly coffee subscription. You can pause, skip, or cancel anytime from your account.

faqs.question: Do you supply cafes or offices?
faqs.answer: Yes, we supply wholesale coffee to cafes, offices, restaurants, and events across Bengaluru, with pan-India shipping for larger accounts. Our wholesale team handles pricing and contracts directly.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: Payments are completed securely through our website checkout. We don't collect payment details over WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Do you have decaf options?
faqs.answer: Yes, we carry Swiss Water process decaf options roasted in small batches.
